name: Bosch ME7.5 (VAG 1.8T 20V, 121-pin)

read_methods.notes: Full flash read and write over K-line in the car or on the bench. See access.bench for the ME7.5 ignition feed and access.boot for open-case recovery.

notes: The classic VAG 1.8 T 20V Motronic (Golf IV, A3 8L, TT 8N, Leon I, Octavia I). OpenTune's me7 checksum (main ROMSYS word-sum + multipoint block) is validated on real ME7.5 dumps. CAN pins 58/60 are listed with opposite polarity by two sources, so they are marked unverified.

pins.note: Transpondery: CAN-L. Nefmoto (ME7.1.1 table): CAN-H. Not needed for K-line bench work.
Transpondery: CAN-H. Nefmoto (ME7.1.1 table): CAN-L. Not needed for K-line bench work.

bench.notes: Minimal, multi-source wiring: +12 V to pins 3 and 62, ground pin 1, K-line pin 43. Nefmoto additionally grounds pin 2 and feeds pin 121 (terminal 15); Transpondery also lists pin 21 as a supply. Boot mode is board-level (see Nefmoto).
bench.resistor_notes: K-line only; no CAN termination needed.

safety_note: Bench safety: use a current-limited bench supply (12-13.8 V, start with a low current limit) and a fuse in the +12 V lead; connect ground first. Confirm every pin with a multimeter on YOUR unit before applying power - ground pins should show continuity to each other (and usually the housing), and hardware revisions can differ from the sources. A CAN bus needs about 60 ohm between CAN-H and CAN-L (two 120 ohm terminations): add a 120 ohm resistor if neither the unit nor your interface terminates. Swapped CAN-H/CAN-L just gives timeouts; +12 V on a signal pin can destroy the unit.

sources.title: Nefmoto wiki: ECU pin outs (ME7.x bench tables)
OpenTune vehicle catalog (catalog/manual, engine to ECU-family mapping)
NefMoto ME7 ECU Flasher (GPL-3.0): Flashing guide (KWP full read/write and ME7.5 bench power)
NefMoto ME7 ECU Flasher (GPL-3.0): Bootmode guide (ME7.5 bootstrap entry)

obd.notes: NefMoto supports full flash reads and writes. A full diagnostic read requires selecting the flash layout for the fitted chip.

bench.how: Use the T121 connector for K-line diagnostics and programming. ECUpinouts lists +12 V on pins 3 and 62, ground on 1 and K-line on 43. NefMoto also lists pin 21 as a supply and requires switched +12 V on pin 121 for ME7.5 programming. Leave CAN disconnected for K-line access.

boot.mcu_mode: C167 serial bootstrap loader over K-line
boot.reset_timing: Apply either strap before switching on ignition power. Release it 2–3 seconds after power-up.
boot.notes: NefMoto describes two alternative contacts for the same bootstrap input. The guide identifies the ME7.5 pad pair in text but illustrates an ME7.1 board.

security.notes: NefMoto attempts login for a full diagnostic read and can continue probing after refusal. The guide does not establish whether this ME7.5 requires security access for a full read or write. OpenTune ships no OEM key.
